---
title: "Sources & method"
---

| Layer | Preferred sources | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| Music identity | MusicBrainz | artists, groups, release groups, releases, recordings, works, relationships |
| Biography | Wikidata + publications | dates, people, places, relationships and narrative events |
| Release detail | Discogs | editions, personnel and production credits |
| Charts | Billboard / Official Charts / archives | historical weekly chart observations |
| Listening | Spotify | current album/track IDs, URIs and links |
| Screen identity | TMDB + IMDb cross-IDs | movies, series, episodes, dates and stable screen IDs |
| Screen music | source-backed soundtrack/sync observations | links from works/recordings to films and TV episodes |
| Analysis | project code / manual / LLM-assisted | themes, candidate claims, networks, derived metrics |

## Provenance

Conflicting source observations should be preserved rather than silently flattened.

## Interpretation

The project distinguishes source-backed fact, published interpretation, manually curated research, LLM-extracted candidate claims, and project-derived analysis. Temporal or thematic overlap does not itself establish causality.
